first_code5_vs_final_apk_zip_comparison.qa_attribution: Visual/runtime QA of the first d6aeb7c0 APK remains bound to that APK. It is not proof of final 9652c638 DEX behavior, even though authored assets/resources/native payloads are byte-identical.
